fields.label: Data Policy ID
fields.help: User-assigned (human readable) ID of the data policy that needs to be unique within a project.

fields.label: Data Policy Type
fields.help: The enrollment level of the service.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The name of the location of the data policy.

fields.label: Policy Tag
fields.help: Policy tag resource name, in the format of projects/{project_number}/locations/{locationId}/taxonomies/{taxonomyId}/policyTags/{policyTag_id}.

fields.label: Data Masking Policy
Routine
fields.help: The name of the BigQuery routine that contains the custom masking routine, in the format of projects/{projectNumber}/datasets/{dataset_id}/routines/{routine_id}.
The data masking policy that specifies the data masking rule to use.
